title: Coverage of Goldreich–Levin stage records
statement: Let the input specify an output dimension $n>0$, a positive rational accuracy at most $1/2$, and an integral Fourier $1$-norm bound at least $1$. Let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $k<n$, and let $A$ be a family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates. At stage $k$, every candidate obtained from a member of $A$ by either leaving it unchanged or adjoining coordinate $k$ occurs as a frequency prefix in some estimate record whose coordinates are precisely the first $k+1$ coordinates.
